notes: Site: panemirates.com 403-redirects to www.panhomestores.com/uae_en/ (Al Seer Group's rebranded UAE storefront, ScandiPWA/Magento 2). Whole origin sits behind a Cloudflare Managed Challenge that blocked curl_cffi (25+ impersonation profiles, tier 1) and headless+headful Playwright (tier 2, --disable-blink-features=AutomationControlled, both got 'Just a moment...' 403/challenge HTML). robots.txt is a blanket 'Disallow: /' for ALL agents (no Claude-specific carve-out or block), so per project rules this is an ordinary WAF site, not a must-decline case -- proceeded to tier 3 (Claude-in-Chrome), which passed the Cloudflare challenge on first real navigation. Checked main nav (Bedroom/Sofas/Dining Room/Living Room/Modular/Household/Office/Outdoor/Kids&Teens/Offers/Pan Blooms/Shop All -- no direct 'Best Sellers' nav item) and the site's own search box. Typing 'best seller' into search produced an autocomplete suggestion chip 'Best sellers' (tag icon, distinct from the plain 'Products (N)' free-text match list below it) that normalizes my query to a different exact string than what I typed -- this, plus a negative-control test (searching a nonsense string 'xyzqwerty123' correctly returned '0 items'/'We are sorry! There were no products found'), confirms the destination page is a genuine tagged merchandising collection, not a blind echo of the query text. Clicking the suggestion navigated to https://www.panhomestores.com/uae_en/search/best%20sellers with breadcrumb 'Home > Best Sellers', on-page H1 'BEST SELLERS', full PLP furniture (Color/Discount range/Features/Categories filters, sort-by, grid/list toggle) with real, fully-loaded product tiles (several carrying 'Best Price' merchandising badges, distinct from the sitewide 'Flat 50% Off' accessories-campaign badge seen elsewhere) and an exact site-reported count of 653 items. This is a single undifferentiated Bestsellers listing spanning all departments (furniture, accessories, etc.) -- no genuine sub-category structure was exposed (Categories is a filter, not separate child pages), so one row only. Did not crawl any PDP.
